jobs.excerpt: Fractional Women's Health Recruiter (Q4) - This is a 3 month contract beginning November 2026, with possible extension(s) and/or conversion to FTE About Diana Health: Diana Health is a high-growth network of modern women's health practices on a mission to set a new standard of care that inspires, empowers, and supports women to live healthier, more fulfilling lives.
jobs.description:
Fractional Women's Health Recruiter (Q4) - This is a 3 month contract beginning November 2026, with possible extension(s) and/or conversion to FTE

About Diana Health: Diana Health is a high-growth network of modern women's health practices on a mission to set a new standard of care that inspires, empowers, and supports women to live healthier, more fulfilling lives. We partner directly with hospitals using integrated care teams, smart technology, and a thoughtfully designed care experience that is good for patients and good for providers. The result is an individualized, comprehensive care program that puts women in the driver's seat of their own health.

We are an interdisciplinary team joined together by a shared commitment to transforming women's health.

Come join us!

Role Description:

We're looking for a Fractional Clinical Recruiter who genuinely loves the human side of hiring. You're the kind of recruiter who remembers the details, follows up because you actually care, and takes real pride in making candidates feel seen throughout the process — not just moved through a pipeline.

In this role, you'll own the full recruitment life cycle for Advanced Practice Provider positions across our multi-state practices, connecting talented CNMs, WHNPs, and other APPs with clinical teams that are doing truly meaningful work for women and families. You'll be a key part of a small, collaborative recruiting team where your contributions are visible, valued, and directly tied to patient impact.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the end-to-end recruiting process for Advanced Practice Provider roles, including:
    • Sourcing passive candidates through platforms like Indeed, LinkedIn, ACNM, and other specialty talent resources, as well as generating referrals
    • Reviewing resumes and initiating thoughtful, personalized outreach to prospective candidates
    • Conducting in-depth initial interviews to assess fit for each site's specific needs
    • Coordinating interviews across multiple stakeholders
    • Building and nurturing candidate pipelines for current and future openings
  • Maintain consistent, proactive communication with candidates throughout the hiring process; escalate questions or concerns to hiring managers and leadership as appropriate
  • Deliver routine and ad hoc hiring status reports and pipeline updates to the Clinical Recruitment Manager
  • Perform other duties as required or assigned that are reasonably within the scope of this role

Experience / Qualifications:

  • A minimum of 1 year of dedicated women's health recruiting experience is REQUIRED
  • Experience recruiting Certified Nurse Midwives (CNMs) and Women's Health Nurse Practitioners (WHNPs) strongly preferred; familiarity with CNM/WHNP scope of practice, credentialing requirements, and compensation benchmarks is a significant plus
  • Demonstrated proficiency with ATS and CRM tools; Greenhouse experience a plus
  • Experience with Google Suite
  • Experience Sourcing passive candidates using multiple hiring tools
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills with a warm, relationship-driven approach
  • Ability to manage multiple searches simultaneously in a fast-paced, remote environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to present information clearly to candidates, hiring managers, and clinical leaders
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and thrive in a remote setting

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation

Diana Health Culture:

  • Growth mindset — continuous learning and improvement are in our DNA
  • Positive, can-do, "how can I help?" attitude
  • Deep empathy for our team, our candidates, and our patients
  • Ownership mentality — we drive to results

jobs.description:
about us:

Spectrum.Life is a whole-of-health digital partner that guides organisations and their people to thrive, delivering clinically backed digital health, mental health and wellbeing solutions.

Our HealthTech delivers digital transformation for Insurers, Educators and Employers through Co-creation or seamlessly integrated out-of-the-box solutions, that decrease digital fragmentation and engage, empower, and transform their people’s lives.

Established in 2018 by Stuart McGoldrick and Stephen Costello, Spectrum.Life provides services internationally to over 7.2m insurance members, 3,000 corporate clients, 60 universities and 650,000 university students. Spectrum.Life currently employs over 450 people.

Our vision is to change and save as many lives as possible.

role brief:

The Lead GP, Virtual Primary Care is the senior clinical and operational leader for Spectrum.Life's regulated Virtual Primary Care service.
This is a full-time leadership position responsible for the clinical leadership, operational management, governance, regulatory compliance and strategic development of the service.
The post holder reports directly to the Chief Clinical Officer and forms part of the senior clinical leadership team.

responsibilities:

Overall responsibility for the safe, effective and compliant delivery of Spectrum.Life's regulated Virtual Primary Care services including:

  • 24-hour, 7-day Virtual Primary Care service
  • General Practice consultations
  • Advanced Nurse Practitioner consultations
  • Clinical triage within the regulated service
  • Psychiatry consultation service delivered under the registered service
  • Psychiatric assessment,diagnosisand management
  • Prescribing of non-controlled prescription medication undertaken within the psychiatry consultation pathway
  • Future regulated clinical services incorporated into the Virtual Primary Care model
Key Responsibilities:

Clinical Leadership

Provide overall clinical leadership for Virtual Primary Care by:
  • Leading the clinical strategy for the service.
  • Ensuring delivery of safe,effectiveand evidence-based care.
  • Developing new clinical pathways.
  • Supporting innovation and service transformation.
  • Leading clinical decision making across the service.
  • Providingexpert clinical advice to internal stakeholders.
  • Supporting future growth and mobilisation activities.
Operational Leadership

Hold overall operational responsibility for the day-to-day delivery of the service including:
  • Clinical operations.
  • Workforce planning.
  • Capacity planning.
  • Clinical rotas.
  • Service performance.
  • Operational KPIs.
  • Workforce productivity.
  • Access standards.
  • Escalation management.
  • Service resilience.
  • Mobilisation of new services.
  • Continuous operational improvement.

Clinical Governance

Provide executive oversight of:

  • Clinical governance.
  • Patient safety.
  • Clinical quality.
  • Clinical effectiveness.
  • Clinical audit.
  • Consultation audit.
  • Prescribing governance.
  • Medicines management.
  • Clinical risk.
  • Incident management.
  • Serious event reviews.
  • Safeguarding.
  • Complaints.
  • Learning from incidents.
  • DCB clinical safety.
  • Clinical policies and procedures.
  • Regulatory compliance.

Workforce Leadership

Professional leadership for:
  • General Practitioners.
  • Advanced Nurse Practitioners.
  • Psychiatrists working within the service.
  • Clinical Leads.
  • Other clinicians working within Virtual Primary Care.
Responsible for:
  • Recruitment.
  • Clinical supervision arrangements.
  • Performance management.
  • Professional development.
  • Clinical competency.
  • Workforce engagement.
  • Clinical leadership.

Client Leadership

Provide senior clinical leadership for client relationships including:
  • Clinical assurance.
  • Governance meetings.
  • Client escalations.
  • Clinical reporting.
  • Mobilisation.
  • Service reviews.
  • Regulatory assurance.
  • Supporting commercial growth.

Financial Responsibility

Responsible for the efficient operational management of the service including:
  • Workforce utilisation.
  • Capacity management.
  • Clinical productivity.
  • Operational efficiency.
  • Service sustainability.
  • Delivery of contractual KPIs.
  • Safe growth.

Senior Leadership

Member of the Clinical Leadership Team.
Contribute to:
  • Clinical strategy.
  • Organisational strategy.
  • Operational planning.
  • Regulatory strategy.
  • Service development.
  • Innovation.
  • Growth initiatives.

Decision Making Authority
Authority to:
  • Lead all clinical and operational decisions relating to Virtual Primary Care.
  • Approve clinical pathways.
  • Implement service improvements.
  • Lead governance initiatives.
  • Escalate strategic risks directly to the Chief Clinical Officer.
  • Make operational decisions relating to regulated services.
Clinical accountability remains with the Chief Clinical Officer.

requirements:

  • Medical degree with full registration and a license to practice with the General Medical Council (GMC).
  • Minimum of 5 years of clinical experience in primary care.
  • Proven experience in a leadership role within a healthcare setting, preferably within digital health or telemedicine services.
  • Significant experience working in digital primary care or remote healthcare environments.
  • Experience supervising and collaborating with GP, allied health clinicians and Advanced Nurse Practitioners (ANPs) in a clinical environment and remote clinical environment.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare regulations, clinical governance, and quality standards.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and manage clinical operations effectively.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with a diverse range of stakeholders.
  • A forward thinking mindset with a passion for leveraging technology to enhance patient care.

desirable:

  • Experience with healthcare IT systems and digital health platforms.
  • Background in service transformation or organisational change management.
  • Knowledge of NICE guidelines and best practice in primary care delivery.

jobs.title: Building Automation - Healthcare Europe Solutions Consultant
jobs.excerpt: The Healthcare Solutions Consultant leads the design and technical architecture of integrated building systems for healthcare environments.
jobs.description:
The Healthcare Solutions Consultant leads the design and technical architecture of integrated building systems for healthcare environments. This role combines deep healthcare domain expertise with strong business acumen to translate patient and medical stuff operational requirements into scalable, high-performance solutions. The position plays a critical role in pre-sales engagements, customer advisory, and cross-functional collaboration to deliver innovative, value-driven system architectures.

This is a remote role that requires travel to client locations, both domestically and internationally, with expected travel of 25% to 50%.

Honeywell

Honeywell Building Automation is transforming the way every building operates to help improve the quality of life for the people who use them. With a portfolio featuring software, hardware and services, Honeywell takes an outcome-focused approach to help building owners and operators improve safety and security, energy and operational efficiencies to create a better building experience.

Helping to Transform Buildings to be Safer and More Operationally and Energy Efficient.

Key responsibilities

System Architecture & Design

  • Lead the design of reference architectures for integrated building systems in healthcare facilities, including:
    • Building Management Systems (BMS)
    • Energy management and control platforms
    • Security, access, video and surveillance solutions
    • Fire and Life Safety solutions
    • RTLS, Nurse Call and specific Healthcare technologies such as water treatment, infection controls and ventilation at ORs & patient rooms, Master System Integration & Cybersecurity
    • Other Low-voltage and connected building technologies
  • Translate customer requirements into scalable, clearly documented solution designs with defined integration and outcome paths. Recommend optimal system architectures aligned with patient experience operational efficiency, energy optimization, and medical stuff safety, security & productivity.
  • Review & Build technical specifications, drawings, and integration requirements for major healthcare projects.

Customer Engagement & Technical Discovery

  • Lead technical discovery sessions to identify customer challenges, goals, and existing environments. Engage with owners, operators, consultants, and partners to understand operational workflows and regional requirements.
  • Act as a trusted advisor throughout the customer journey, building strong relationships and credibility, with insights to customers KPIs (ie. EQI). Clearly communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Pre-Sales & Solution Consulting

  • Provide technical leadership in pre-sales engagements (no direct quota responsibility). Design customized solutions that align product capabilities to customer needs and business outcomes.
  • Deliver tailored product demonstrations that highlight solution value and return on investment (ROI). Lead architecture discussions, validate feasibility, and address technical objections. Translate technical features into clear business benefits through compelling storytelling.

Continuous Improvement & Industry Expertise

  • Maintain an understanding of healthcare design principles including uptime, redundancy, resilience, and operational continuity. Analyze customer specifications and single-line diagrams to deliver optimized, cost-effective solutions. Support product lifecycle management and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Represent technical value in customer presentations, design reviews, and industry discussions. Knowledgeable on the latest development and drivers for healthcare, including ventilation, infection control and energy efficiency.

Key skills and qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field preferred
  • 5+ years in Healthcare application engineering, solution proposal or solution consulting OR 5+ years in Healthcare Facility Management Leadership AND 3+ years designing building systems in healthcare environments
  • Strong expertise in healthcare building systems, controls, and integration technologies
  • Proven ability to translate customer, patient and medical stuff into technical solutions. Ability to analyze technical specifications and propose cost-effective alternatives
  • Business acumen to connect technical solutions with measurable outcomes. Strong storytelling and presentation skills for customer engagement. Excellent relationship-building and stakeholder management capabilities
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and willingness to learn configuration/pricing tools
  • Experience in healthcare settings (Hospitals, Retirement care homes, Clinics). Knowledge of smart Hospital ecosystems. Ability to identify market opportunities and drive innovation initiatives. Experience influencing product strategy or standardization efforts

Our offer

  • Work for a well-known brand with a continued focus on innovation and growth.
  • Join a dynamic team where most leaders are promoted from within
  • A culture that fosters inclusion, diversity, and innovation

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Join us nowand be part of a global team of thinkers, innovators, dreamers, and doers who make the things that make the future!
